intro: Loose gravel and dirt over rough, hilly land, with crests that throw you into the air. Everyone is on the stage at once: first across the line after the last lap wins.
inspiredBy: Rally driving goes back over a hundred years, and rallycross put everyone on the course together. Rally is our own take, with our own cars, stages and drivers.
goal: Be first across the line after the last lap. Races are 1, 2, 3 or 5 laps of a stage.
howToPlay: Join with your phone, or race the computer drivers on your own.
In the lobby, choose the stage, how many computer drivers, how many laps and how quick they are, then press {bolt} to start.
Your phone becomes a steering pad: slide your thumb left and right to steer. Hold {bolt} for gas and {drop} to brake. Hold {drop} when you've stopped to reverse.
The road is loose: brake before the bends, not in them. Pull {leaf}, the handbrake, to swing the back round in a hairpin.

Watch the top of your screen (and your phone) for your co-driver's calls: which way the next bend goes and how tight it is, from 2 (very tight) to 6 (nearly flat out), and crests, jumps, dips and water.
Crests throw you into the air, more the faster you take them. In the air, the gas lifts the nose and the brake drops it: land on all four wheels.
Stuck, upside down or lost in the trees? Press {l1} to get back on the road. If you can't, you're put back after a few seconds anyway.
steering: Slide left and right on your phone to steer (or use the arrow keys)
tips: Land a big jump nose-down and you'll bottom out and lose speed. A touch of gas in the air levels the car.
The heavy cars and the 4x4 soak up rough ground; the light ones are quicker through the bends but get knocked about.
Cutting across the land doesn't count: only the road takes you round.

Choose the weather in the lobby: rain turns dirt to mud and tarmac slippery (gravel hardly minds), and snow covers everything. The cars run studded tyres on snow, but it's still the slipperiest there is: brake early and use the handbrake gently.
Hold {r1} to see who's behind you.
